evidence.observation: o2_exhaust not_installed, but the growth stage requires it to verify the atmosphere
Growth temperature settled at 750.0-750.2 °C after a brief overshoot to 760.8 °C
Steady at about 760 Torr throughout; at atmospheric pressure this cannot rule out an air leak
Argon flow tracks the setpoint (about 99-100 sccm)
Steady at about 46%, consistent with holding temperature

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading, or another atmosphere check such as a leak-up or helium leak test, to confirm the tube is free of oxygen during growth; later, characterization of the sample.
